turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so start with who decided that and on what basis.
You asked for this meeting, so you can skip the pleasantries. Who entered that zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Crazy weather today, eh? Did you see the Flames game?
We're not here about hockey, Hale. You're stalling, and I'm writing that down. The zero, now, or I walk down to the principal's office.
What do you do for fun?
That's mine, Hale. Twice now you've avoided the zero, so either you give me an answer or I'm going to the principal's office next.
